title: Changing Prices
summary: Addresses supplementary information showing the effects of changing prices on financial statements; largely dormant with voluntary requirements since SFAS 89 (1986).
description: ASC 255 addresses supplementary information showing the effects of changing prices on financial statements – specifically, constant purchasing power and current cost restatements. Its substantive disclosure requirements were made voluntary by SFAS 89 in 1986 and are essentially unused today.

bannerNotice.title: Largely Dormant
bannerNotice.body: Substantive requirements made voluntary in 1986 (SFAS 89); rarely applied in current practice.
